Tavern killing: 12 people including a three-year old were shot and killed at
an illegal shebeen operating at a hostel room in Saulsville and 13 others
were injured.

Tavern killing: Seven men and two women were killed in Bekkersdal by
twelve unidentified gunmen who arrived in two vehicles and opened fire at
patrons in a tavern. The suspects continued to shoot randomly and injured
other ten people that were trying to escape.

Tavern killing: Seven people were gunned down at a shebeen in Marikana
informal settlement and the victims included a woman and six men,. Two
other people were wounded and taken to a medical facility for treatment. It is
suspected that the incident could be extortion related.

Tavern killing: Two suspects stormed in a tavern and demanded a firearm
from a patron. They shot at him and took his firearm and started shooting
randomly killing five people and injuring two.

Argument-related: During an argument a suspect stabbed and killed five
victims (four males and one female) and the suspect was found hanging on
a tree.
Assault with the intent to inflict grievous bodily harm
